blurb: The Alberni Valley Soaring Association (AVSA) is a non-profit, volunteer-run organization dedicated to promoting engine-less flight in sailplanes on Vancouver Island. The AVSA operates in concert with the Vancouver Island Soaring Centre from the Alberni Valley Regional Airport in Port Alberni, British Columbia, Canada.
